lines.zh: 爪子在石地上敲出轻响。
lines.en: My claws tap lightly on the stone floor.

lines.zh: 我歪头听着洞里的滴水声。
lines.en: I tilt my head to the cave's dripping.
I tilt my head and listen to you breathe.
I pace back and forth at the cave mouth.
I let out an odd cry, then fall silent.
My claws scratch the dirt, restless.
I stare at the wall as if at a face.

lines.zh: 我的羽毛底下有东西在动。

lines.en: Do not look back. I am behind you.

lines.zh: 翅膀被打歪了，爪子还在。
lines.en: My wing's bent, but the claws still work.

lines.zh: 我的嗉囊被打瘪，叫不出声。
lines.en: My crop is crushed; I can't cry out.

lines.zh: 我的鸡冠垂下来，声音也哑了。
lines.en: My comb droops and my voice is gone.

lines.zh: 我绕圈跑，爪子在地面划出痕。
lines.en: I run in circles, claws scoring the ground.

lines.zh: 苍白的羽毛在月光下闪烁，你无法移开视线。
lines.en: Pale feathers gleam under moonlight, drawing your gaze.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，它向你逼近，眼神充满渴望。
lines.en: Sibilant hiss as it approaches, eyes filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它啄食你手中的食物，眼神中露出狡猾。
lines.en: It pecks at your food, eyes showing cunning.

lines.zh: 它在夜幕中低语，似乎有不详的预感。
lines.en: It whispers in the night, with a foreboding feeling.

lines.zh: 被附身的鸡发出诡异的叫声，令人不安。
lines.en: Possessed chicken makes eerie sounds, unsettling.

lines.zh: 它跳上你的肩膀，似乎要向你传达什么。
lines.en: It hops onto your shoulder, as if conveying something.

lines.zh: 它的羽毛中透出幽幽绿光，引诱你靠近。
lines.en: Its feathers glow with a green light, tempting you closer.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛反射出你心中的恐惧，你感到一阵寒意。
lines.en: Its eyes mirror your fear, sending shivers down your spine.

lines.zh: 它在黑暗中移动，几乎看不见，却无处不在。
lines.en: It moves in the dark, invisible yet everywhere.

lines.zh: 它在你耳边低语，声音如毒蛇般嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: It whispers in your ear, voice hissing like a snake.

lines.zh: 你和它猛然相撞，感到一阵刺痛。
lines.en: You collide with it, feeling a sharp pain.

lines.zh: 它冲向你，坚硬的爪子击中你。
lines.en: It rushes at you, hard claws striking you.

lines.zh: 被附身的鸡用尖喙啄你，力量惊人。
lines.en: The possessed chicken pecks at you with surprising force.

lines.zh: 你和它碰撞，它的力量远远超出普通鸡。
lines.en: You collide with it, its strength far exceeds a normal chicken.

lines.zh: 你被它推倒，感到它的力量非同寻常。
lines.en: You are pushed down by it, feeling its extraordinary strength.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀拍击，你感到一阵风击。
lines.en: Its wings beat, sending a wind strike.

lines.zh: 你和它撞在一起，它的力量让你喘不过气。
lines.en: You collide with it, its strength making you gasp.

lines.zh: 它突然向你扑来，力量惊人。
lines.en: It suddenly lunges at you, with surprising strength.

lines.zh: 你躲避它的攻击，被逼得退后几步。
lines.en: You dodge its attack, retreating a few steps.

lines.zh: 它猛然冲撞，让你失去平衡。
lines.en: It suddenly crashes into you, throwing you off balance.

lines.zh: 它注视着同类，眼神中充满渴望。
lines.en: It looks at its同类, eyes filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它发出低沉的叫声，寻求伴侣。
lines.en: It makes a low call, seeking a mate.

lines.zh: 两只被附身的鸡在月光下互相低语。
lines.en: Two possessed chickens whisper under moonlight.

lines.zh: 它和同类相依偎，眼神中透露出爱意。
lines.en: It cuddles with its同类, eyes showing love.

lines.zh: 它靠近同类，试图用眼神吸引它。
lines.en: It approaches its同类, trying to attract it with its gaze.

lines.zh: 它们在月光下窃窃私语，眼神中充满情愫。
lines.en: They whisper under moonlight, eyes full of emotion.

lines.zh: 它和同类互相啄食，眼神中透出亲密。
lines.en: It pecks at its同类, eyes showing intimacy.

lines.zh: 它向同类示好，眼神中充满渴望。
lines.en: It approaches its同类, eyes filled with desire.

lines.zh: 它们在月光下相依偎，眼神中充满爱意。
lines.en: They cuddle under moonlight, eyes full of love.

lines.zh: 它们互相低语，眼神中透出亲密。
lines.en: They whisper to each other, eyes showing intimacy.
Pale feathers sway in the wind.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛闪烁着邪恶的光芒。
羽毛在夜色中更显苍白。
lines.en: Feathers appear even paler at night.
A possessed chicken no longer pecks grain.
It fixes on a nearby villager.

lines.zh: 目标是那个孤身的旅人。

lines.en: Its gaze is cold and unfeeling.

lines.zh: 瞄准了一只正在觅食的兔子。

lines.en: Stares at the distant water source.

lines.zh: 锁定了一个在田间劳作的人。
lines.en: Locks onto a farmer in the fields.

lines.zh: 视线聚焦在一个孤独的旅者。
注意到了正在探险的冒险者。

lines.en: Everything in the cave is useful.
Once locked on, I never let go.

lines.zh: 一步步接近，不发出声音。
悄悄靠近，以免惊动目标。
小心翼翼地接近，以防惊扰。
悄悄地靠近，以免被发现。
lines.en: Creeps close, to avoid being seen.
Closing in, waiting for the right moment.

lines.zh: 悄悄靠近，目标已感不安。
慢慢接近，等待最佳时机。
lines.en: Approaching slowly, waiting for the perfect moment.
Hugging the rock wall, I creep closer.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，翅膀扑棱起来。
尖喙啄向你，你颤抖不已。
lines.en: Sharp beak pecks at you, making you shiver.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，逼近你。
lines.en: Makes a low growl, advancing on you.
Uses sharp claws, causing intense pain.
Pecks at you, causing you to dodge.

lines.zh: 扑向你，爪子抓破你的皮肤。
lines.en: Pounces on you, claws shredding your skin.

lines.zh: 凶猛地扑向你，你惊恐尖叫。
lines.en: Roughly lunges at you, making a frightened scream.
There's no chicken in this chicken's eyes.
Hatches in an ancient underground city.

lines.zh: 我从矿洞的黑处走出来。
lines.en: I step out of the dark of a mineshaft.
The possession crawls out of the shadow.
A clucking comes from behind the stone.

lines.zh: 羽毛一燎就卷，肉味都出来了。
lines.en: My feathers curl in the flame; I smell roast.

lines.zh: 附身的鸡，翅膀拍不动了。
lines.en: Possessed wings can't catch the fall.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛，我的叫声断了。
lines.en: Water fills my feathers; my cry cuts off.
The blast leaves every feather standing!

lines.zh: 箭穿过羽毛，把我钉在地上。
lines.en: An arrow through my feathers pins me down.

lines.zh: 咒光打中翅膀，我歪着飞。
lines.en: Spell light hits my wing; I fly crooked.
I am too starved to make a sound.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，鸡爪还在乱抓。
lines.en: The floor vanishes; my claws still scratch.
